subtitle: 寫一封正式信件給國際處，說明自己為何適合交換計畫
task: Your university is selecting students for a one-semester exchange program at a partner university in Japan. Write a formal email to the exchange program coordinator. Introduce yourself, explain why you are a strong candidate, describe what you hope to gain from the program, and ask about the next steps in the selection process.
taskZh: 你的大學正在甄選學生，到日本的姊妹校交換一學期。寫一封正式 email 給交換計畫承辦人：介紹自己、說明你為什麼是合適的人選、描述你希望從計畫中獲得什麼，並詢問甄選的後續步驟。
focus: 正式語氣與完整的 email 格式
以具體成績與經驗支持自己是合適人選
段落分工清楚：自我介紹、條件、目標、請求
進階句型（分詞構句、倒裝）正確且自然

en: I am a third-year economics student, and I am writing to express my strong interest in the spring exchange program with our partner university in Osaka. Having read the program guidelines carefully, I believe my academic background and experience make me a suitable candidate.

Over the past two years, I have maintained a GPA of 3.8 and completed four courses taught entirely in English. In addition, I have studied Japanese for three years and passed the JLPT N3 last July. As a volunteer guide for international students on our campus, I have also learned how to adapt to different cultural expectations, which I expect will help me settle in quickly abroad.

Through this program, I hope to take courses on regional development that are not offered at our university. I would also like to compare how small towns in Japan and Taiwan deal with aging populations, a topic I plan to explore in my graduation project. Not only would this experience broaden my perspective, but it would also give my research a solid international basis.
Could you kindly let me know what documents are required and when the interviews will take place? I have attached my transcript and language certificate for your reference.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to hearing from you.
zh: 我是經濟系三年級學生，寫信是想表達我對與大阪姊妹校合作的春季交換計畫有高度興趣。仔細閱讀計畫說明後，我相信自己的學業背景與經驗使我成為合適的人選。
過去兩年，我的 GPA 維持在 3.8，並修完四門全英語授課的課程。此外，我學了三年日文，並在去年 7 月通過日檢 N3。身為本校國際學生的志工導覽員，我也學會如何因應不同的文化期待，我想這能幫助我在國外很快適應。
透過這項計畫，我希望修習本校沒有開設的區域發展課程。我也想比較日本和台灣的小鎮如何因應人口老化，這是我打算在畢業專題中探討的主題。這段經驗不僅能拓展我的視野，也能為我的研究奠定扎實的國際基礎。
能否請您告訴我需要準備哪些文件，以及面試將在何時舉行？我已附上成績單與語言檢定證書供您參考。
感謝您考慮我的申請。期待您的回覆。

patterns.pattern: I am writing to express my strong interest in …
patterns.zh: 寫信表達對……的高度興趣（申請信開頭）
patterns.example: I am a third-year economics student, and I am writing to express my strong interest in the spring exchange program with our partner university in Osaka.

patterns.zh: 完成式分詞構句：在……之後，我……
patterns.example: Having read the program guidelines carefully, I believe my academic background and experience make me a suitable candidate.

patterns.zh: 關係子句插入 I expect，說明預期的好處
patterns.example: As a volunteer guide for international students on our campus, I have also learned how to adapt to different cultural expectations, which I expect will help me settle in quickly abroad.

patterns.pattern: Not only would …, but it would also …
patterns.example: Not only would this experience broaden my perspective, but it would also give my research a solid international basis.

patterns.pattern: Could you kindly let me know …?
patterns.zh: 能否請您告訴我……？（正式請求）
patterns.example: Could you kindly let me know what documents are required and when the interviews will take place?
keys: could you kindly let me know
